title: Minimum Temperature Delta Tracker
description: Given a list of daily temperature deltas, return the highest (least negative or most positive) reading. Return 0 if the list is empty.

test_cases.description: Edge case: All negative readings (must return -3, not 0)
Edge case: Empty reading list returns 0

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Zero initialization instead of first element
candidate_mutations.explanation: Initializes `highest = 0`, breaking only all-negative test E4 while E1, E2, E3, E5 pass (1/5 broken).

title: CPU Quota Throttling Threshold Checker
description: Sum positive CPU usage units, apply a 20% surcharge (* 1.2) if usage >= 50.0, and round to 2 decimals.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Exact 50.0 threshold triggers 20% surcharge
Edge case: Two-decimal rounding with negative credit noise ignored

candidate_mutations.explanation: Uses `total > 50.0` instead of `>= 50.0`, breaking only E4 (1/5 broken).

title: Leaderboard Top-N Selector with Alphabetical Tie-Break
description: Return top n player names sorted by points descending, and player name ascending on ties.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Equal points tie-broken alphabetically ascending

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Reverse tuple sort breaking alphabetical tie-break
candidate_mutations.explanation: Reverses both score and name order on ties, breaking only E4 (1/5 broken).

title: Consecutive Signal Packet Bundler
mlcq_category: MLCQ: Singleton Guard & Loop State Debt
description: Group consecutive identical packet codes into (code, count) pairs. Return [] for empty input.

candidate_mutations.explanation: Drops single-packet streams via `len(packets) <= 1`, breaking only E4 (1/5 broken).

title: Sequential Memory Pool Block Allocator
mlcq_category: MLCQ: State Rollback & Exact Capacity Debt
description: Allocate `req_mb` across memory blocks in order and return remaining block sizes. If total free memory < req_mb, return original blocks unchanged.

test_cases.description: Edge case: Exact total capacity allocation
Edge case: Over-capacity request returns original blocks unchanged

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: Omit total capacity pre-check before mutating blocks
candidate_mutations.explanation: Omits `if sum(blocks) < req_mb: return list(blocks)`, breaking only E5 (1/5 broken).

title: API Version Tuple Normalizer & Comparator
mlcq_category: MLCQ: Numeric vs Lexicographic Version Debt
description: Compare two dotted version strings 'x.y.z' (missing parts default to 0). Return 1 if a > b, -1 if a < b, 0 if equal.

candidate_mutations.strategy_name: String segment comparison without int conversion
candidate_mutations.explanation: Compares segments as strings so '12' < '3', breaking only E4 (1/5 broken).
